script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NC" --quiet --check agent.condenser eq null
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOOP" --quiet --check agent.condenser.kind eq NoOpCondenser
N_NC=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NC/events/count" --field .)
N_NOOP=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOOP/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NC/condense" --expect 4xx,5xx --check . matches 'No condenser configured' --save F10.condense-no-condenser/disabled
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOOP/condense" --expect 4xx,5xx --check . matches 'NoOpCondenser does not handle condensation requests' --save F10.condense-no-condenser/no-op
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NC/events/count" --check . eq "$N_NC"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOOP/events/count" --check . eq "$N_NOOP"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOOP/events/count" --query kind=$CREQ --check . eq 0
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NC" --quiet --check execution_status eq idle
